entities.summary: Jeffrey Foskett was an American guitarist and singer, notable as a touring and studio musician for Brian Wilson and the Beach Boys beginning in the 1980s. Foskett was described as the Beach Boys' "vice principal" by its touring members. In 1996, he debuted as a solo artist with the album Thru My Window and continued releasing albums until 2019.
